section: Part 2 Defect Re-Verification (27-Oct)
scenario: Re-verify DEFECT-20261027-06: Split shift overlapping intervals rejected with HTTP 400 Bad Request
input_pre: Send POST /worktemplates/split with Day 1 intervals 08:00-12:00 and 11:00-15:00 (1 hour overlap).
expected: HTTP 400 Bad Request with message 'Split intervals on a working day must not overlap and must have a break gap.'
remarks: [Re-verified 28-Oct-2026]: FAIL (HTTP 500 CRASH). FluentValidation rule was added in domain layer, but unhandled ValidationException causes ASP.NET Core to return HTTP 500 Internal Server Error instead of HTTP 400 Bad Request due to missing exception middleware mapping.
